# Feedback

> A feedback button for any website and an inbox for what visitors send: issues, ideas and
> questions, with files, ratings and your own questions. Hosted at https://feedback.zyt.app.
> It is an open-source Holm app: https://github.com/holmhq/unofficial-apps/tree/main/feedback

Each site gets a **project**. The project's snippet adds the button; what visitors send lands in
that project's inbox at `https://feedback.zyt.app/projects/<id>`.

## Add the button to a site

Paste the project's snippet before `</body>` in the site's shared layout (or on every page):

```html
<script src="https://feedback.zyt.app/embed.js" data-project="abcd2345" async></script>
```

The button reads the project's look (text, colour, side, style, panel theme) as the page loads,
so later changes need no new snippet. Attributes on the tag win over the project's settings:

- `data-label` — the button's text (default `Feedback`).
- `data-color` — `#rrggbb`.
- `data-position` — `right` or `left`.
- `data-button` — `pill`, `icon`, or `none` to open the form from your own control.
- `data-theme` — the panel's: `light`, `dark` or `auto`.
- `data-preload="hover"` — load the form only when the pointer reaches the button. By default
  the form loads in the background once the page is idle, so it opens at once (readers with
  Save-Data on get hover loading too). Loading is not counted as an open.

From your own link or button: `HolmFeedback.open()`, `.close()`, `.toggle()` and `.preload()`.
`HolmFeedback.ready` is true, and a `holmfeedback:ready` event fires on `window`, once the
button is set up, so a link of your own can wait to show. The page address is sent without its
query or fragment.

### On a site that is itself a Holm app

Holm pages run only their own scripts. Copy `https://feedback.zyt.app/embed.js` into the site
(re-copy it to pick up new versions), point the tag at the copy, say where feedback lives, and
put the look on the tag:

```html
<script src="/embed.js" data-project="abcd2345" data-origin="https://feedback.zyt.app" data-color="#1d4ed8" async></script>
```

Then the site's operator lets its pages frame the form (ask them first; it changes the site's
policy):

```sh
holm @<peer> policy set security.csp.frame_src "https://feedback.zyt.app" --app <site-app-id>
```

## Owner API

Base URL `https://feedback.zyt.app`. Make a key in the app under the avatar menu → API keys.
Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on every owner route. Replies are JSON: `ok: true`, or
`ok: false` with `error.code` and `error.message`. The key acts as its owner on all their projects.

### Projects

- `GET /api/projects` — your projects.
- `POST /api/projects` — make one (JSON, fields below). The reply's `project.snippet` is the tag
  to paste; `project.id` names its inbox.
- `GET /api/projects/<id>` — one project, with `snippet` and `board`.
- `PATCH /api/projects/<id>` — change any field below.
- `DELETE /api/projects/<id>` — delete it and everything in it.
- `GET /api/projects/<id>/stats?days=30` — daily counts and totals, top pages, kinds and ratings;
  `GET /api/stats?days=30` gives daily counts and totals across all projects.
- `GET /api/projects/<id>/installs` — the sites the button was seen on.

Fields: `name` (≤60), `label` (button text), `color` (`#rrggbb`), `position` (`right`, `left`),
`button` (`pill`, `icon`, `none`), `theme` (`light`, `dark`, `auto`), `origins` (list of
`https://host` the form may be sent from; empty accepts any site), `icon` (the mark shown when
there is no logo: one of 48 named icons such as `flame`, `rocket`, `globe`, `code`, `terminal`,
`bot`, `package`, `heart`, `star`, or `letter` for the name's initial), `attachments` (boolean),
`for` (`site` for issue/idea/question, or `place` for praise/problem/idea), `contact`
(`{"email": "optional", "phone": "off"}`, each `off`, `optional` or `required`), `rating`
(`{"ask": "off", "label": ""}`), `fields` (up to eight questions, each `{"type": "text" | "select"
| "radio" | "checkbox", "label", "required", "options"}`), `public` (the public board at
`/b/<id>`), `slug` (a custom board address, 3–40 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens), `title` and
`intro` (the form's and board's heading and text).

```sh
curl https://feedback.zyt.app/api/projects -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My blog","origins":["https://blog.example.com"],"color":"#1d4ed8"}'
```

### Logo and cover

The logo leads the form and the board; without one the project shows its `icon`. The cover is
the board's wide banner.

- `POST /api/projects/<id>/logo` and `POST /api/projects/<id>/cover` — multipart upload of one
  PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF up to 10 MB. A logo is fitted inside 512 px as PNG (transparency kept);
  a cover is cropped to 1800 × 640 JPEG.
- `DELETE /api/projects/<id>/logo` (or `/cover`) — back to the default.

```sh
curl -X POST https://feedback.zyt.app/api/projects/<id>/logo \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -F "file=@logo.png;type=image/png"
```

**Use the site's own icon.** Read the site's home page head and take the largest square image
from, in order: `<link rel="apple-touch-icon">`, `<link rel="icon" type="image/png">` with the
biggest `sizes`, the web app manifest's `icons`, then `/apple-touch-icon.png` or
`/favicon.png`. Skip SVG and ICO (not accepted); prefer 180 px or larger. Download it and upload
it as above. Match `color` to the site's brand colour (its `<meta name="theme-color">` or main
accent).

### Items (what visitors sent)

- `GET /api/projects/<id>/items?status=<s>` — the inbox. `status` is `new`, `planned`,
  `progress`, `done`, `closed`, or `open` for new + planned + progress; omit it for all.
- `PATCH /api/items/<item-id>` — `status`, `kind` (`issue`, `idea`, `question`, `praise`,
  `problem`), `public` (show on the board), `title`.
- `DELETE /api/items/<item-id>`.
- `GET` and `POST /api/items/<item-id>/notes` — private notes, `{"body": "..."}`.
- `GET` and `POST /api/items/<item-id>/comments` — board comments; `POST` replies as the owner.
  `PATCH /api/comments/<id>` with `{"approved": true}` publishes a visitor's comment;
  `DELETE /api/comments/<id>` removes it.

An item has `id`, `number` (the `#12` shown in the app), `kind`, `status`, `title`, `body`,
`email` (may be empty), `page`, `pageTitle`, `browser`, `viewport`, `votes`, `public` and
`createdAt`. Link one as `https://feedback.zyt.app/projects/<project-id>/items/<number>`.

### Open the inbox without signing in

- `POST /api/projects/<id>/link` — returns `{"url": "https://feedback.zyt.app/v/<token>",
  "expiresAt": "..."}`. Hand the `url` to the person; don't open it yourself.

The link opens once, within 5 minutes; a second open, or a later one, shows "Inbox locked". The
page shows that project's inbox and items, where they can sort, note and reply, but not delete
or change settings. It locks after 5 minutes without activity (a bar counts down and fills
again at any touch) or 8 hours whatever happens, and then clears itself. To see it again, ask
for a new link.

## For AI assistants (MCP)

`https://feedback.zyt.app/_holm/mcp` is an MCP endpoint with two public tools: `projects_get`
(a widget's public settings) and `feedback_submit` (send text or rated feedback; it requires an
`idempotency_key`, reused only to retry the same input, so a retry is never sent twice). Owner tools (inbox, triage, settings) need sign-in, which is
not available yet; use the owner API above.

## Rules for agents

- Reuse a site's existing project (`GET /api/projects`, match `origins`); don't make a second.
- Set the new project's `color` and logo from the site itself (see "Use the site's own icon").
- Keep the key where the owner keeps it; never print, log or commit it. On a 401, ask the owner
  for a key instead of retrying.
- Don't delete projects, items or comments, or turn a board public, unless asked to.
- Feedback can hold visitors' emails: summarise it for the owner, never post it publicly.
- After adding the button, load the page and check the button opens the form.
